_comment: Anything at scene root NOT listed here is flagged by Tools/check-scene-roots.py.
Why this file exists: package installs and MCP tools have twice injected a
root object that would have shipped in the Lens (the RemoteServiceGateway
examples prefab, and AiPreviewAgent Handler from the runtime-inspection
tool). Those are silent - nothing errors, the object just rides along into
the commit. This is the tripwire.
Adding a name here is a deliberate act. If the checker flags something you
actually want, add it WITH a reason in 'notes' - do not just silence it.
'must_be_disabled_trees' enforces hard rule 1: every object in those
trees must ship disabled. This drifts silently - ticking a checkbox in
the Objects panel while inspecting is enough to break it.

notes.SpectaclesInteractionKit: SIK prefab. Required for hand interaction.
notes.VisualConfig: Theme @input holder. Enabled on purpose; draws nothing.
notes.RSG Smoke Test [TEMP]: TEMPORARY diagnostic - remove this entry when RsgSmokeTest.ts is deleted.
notes.Systems: Always-enabled container for runtime controllers (VoiceInput, StatusBarPresenter). Must stay ENABLED: HUDRoot/WorldRoot ship disabled per hard rule 1, so something enabled has to turn them on.
notes.DEMO_ENV [PREVIEW ONLY]: PREVIEW-ONLY demo diorama (ground, river, treeline, camp tent). Origin: built in an earlier session's uncommitted work, adopted into the scene 2026-08-21; owned by whoever is shooting desk captures / the demo video - it is scenery for the Preview panel, nothing subscribes to it. Not part of the Lens: the SPECS waveguide is additive, so this geometry can only ever read as a ghost overlay on device. MUST BE DISABLED before any device run or publish; nothing structural prevents it shipping, so 'must_be_disabled_roots' below makes the pre-commit check the tripwire. Children stay enabled on purpose - the root is the one switch. See Docs/SCENE-MAP.md.

known_offenders.RemoteServiceGatewayExamples: Auto-added by InstallLensStudioPackage for RemoteServiceGateway. Delete it; it carries placeholder credential fields.
known_offenders.AiPreviewAgent Handler: Auto-added by the Lens Studio MCP runtime scene-inspection tool. Delete it; the package is git-ignored.
known_offenders.APIKeyWarning: Ships with some RSG example scenes. Not needed here.
known_offenders.GUIDE_ReadAndDisable: Ships with some RSG example scenes. Not needed here.
known_offenders.LEAF Plugin Bridge: Auto-added by the LeafPlugin panel when a scenario runs. Delete before committing; it re-injects on the next test run. The LEAF SUITE itself lives at Systems/LeafIndex and is committed.
